summary: Two well-equipped Front Range climbers fell several hundred feet into a couloir on Quandary Peak and could not get out; they called for help and the Summit County Rescue Group completed an eight-hour rescue mission; both escaped without serious harm.
location: couloir on Quandary Peak near Breckenridge
notes: Run-762 Summit Daily chunk. Date pinned from the 2024-05-28 litwick.net post ("last Wednesday" -> Wednesday 2024-05-22). Secondary source citing Summit Daily reporter Ryan Spencer; the Summit Daily article itself was unreachable this run. | MERGED run 814: Denver Post "IN BRIEF" (parent-opened) — same 2024-05-22 Quandary Peak south-side couloir rescue: two Front Range hikers fell/slid into a tight couloir, 8-hr technical mission, 17 SCRG members, back to safety ~10 p.m. Wednesday; Summit Daily attribution in piece.
